record.kind: marker passive without a PassiveEffects entry (no combat effect found)
record.summary: Passive.FAMILY has no entry in PassiveEffects. PokemonEntity.changePassive looks up PassiveEffects[newPassive] ?? [], so the entity installs no passive effects for it, and a name search of the pinned app code (excluding built client files) finds the identifier only in the enum and in the class blocks of TANDEMAUS and MAUSHOLD_THREE; no code branches on it. The passive therefore does nothing in a fight in the traced code. The two units carry it alongside class-level STATE evolution rules (Tandemaus into MAUSHOLD_THREE when stageLevel >= 15, MAUSHOLD_THREE into MAUSHOLD_FOUR when stageLevel >= 20); those rules belong to the unit classes and the shared StateEvolutionHandler (Eviolite blocks them, the unit must be on the board) and are not driven by the passive identifier. MAUSHOLD_FOUR declares no passive in its class block.
triggers: none: no effect object is installed for this identifier
